Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?

Once an order has started processing, I’m not able to speed it up or upgrade the shipping method mid-order. The fastest option is to place a new order with Expedited or Overnight shipping at checkout, then return the original order once it arrives if you no longer need it.

If you send me your order number or the email used at checkout, I can check whether your current order may still arrive in time.

How do I find my tracking link?

You can find your tracking link in 2 places:

Your shipping confirmation email, the subject usually says “Your Spanx.com order has shipped.” Click the tracking number in that email.
Your SPANX account under Order History.

If you don’t see the email, check your spam or junk folder too. If you send me your order number or the email used at checkout, I can help you look into it.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?

In most cases, no, I’m not able to reroute a package to a different address once the order has been processed or shipped. If it’s still very early, there may be a short window to cancel and place a new order with the correct address.

Send me your order number or the email used at checkout, and I’ll check what’s still possible for your order.

Do you compensate for a long delay?

Yes, in some delay situations we can help with things like refunding the shipping paid or waiving the return fee, depending on the order status and how long it’s been delayed. If an order is significantly stalled, I can also review replacement options.

Send me your order number or the email used at checkout, and I’ll check exactly what applies to your order.
